resumen: Standing facing a high pulley, you pull a rope towards your face, separating the hands with the elbows high. It works the back of the shoulder and the area between the shoulder blades.
ejecucion: Set the pulley at face height or slightly higher and take the rope with both hands, palms facing in.
Step back until your arms are straight and the cable is taut.
Pull the rope towards your face with your elbows high, at shoulder height, separating your hands at the end.
Return by straightening your arms under control, without letting the cable pull you forward.
matices: We have found no study measuring the face pull itself. That it works the rear deltoid and the muscles between the shoulder blades comes from the movement —pulling with high elbows and separating the hands—, not from a measurement. It is also often used for the shoulder external rotators, which this muscle map does not draw.
